pr_title: Allow text_expansion query to use sparse_vector field type
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/99749

Adds explicit tests on text_expansion query to ensure it is compatible with both `sparse_vector` and `rank_features` field types.

issue_context.title: Allow text_expansion query to use sparse_vector field type
issue_context.body:
### Description

Currently, `text_expansion` queries are limited to using rank_features field types.

As we [brought back sparse_vector](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/98104) field type, we want text_expansion queries to be able to work with `sparse_vector` fields as well.

`rank_features` field type should keep being usable in `text_expansion` queries. We don't want to deprecate until the UI and clients that set this up are ready to migrate to `sparse_vector`.

review_comments: Add duplicate tests for `rank_features` and `sparse_vector` field types
